commit 5089b0d319207ce1ef436b9c97f1bf801ff55a4c
Author: ddx-checkpoint <checkpoint@ddx.local>
Date:   Fri May 29 02:35:32 2026 -0400

    fix(routing): include available subscription-harness tiers in unfiltered ListModels [fizeau-6506be18]
    
    When the configured providers block is unreachable (or empty) but
    subscription CLI harnesses (claude/codex/gemini) are available on PATH,
    ListModels(ModelFilter{}) returned zero models, emptying the caller's
    power-escalation ladder and producing "no viable routing floor".
    
    Root cause: unfiltered ListModels assembled models only from the provider
    snapshot; subscription-harness tiers were returned only when filter.Harness
    was set (the listModelsForSubprocessHarness path).
    
    Fix: extract the per-harness tier-building loop into a reusable helper
    service.subscriptionHarnessTierModels(name, cfg, cat) and call it from both
    the harness-pinned path and the unfiltered path. The unfiltered path now
    enumerates registry.Discover() and appends tiers for every available
    subprocess subscription harness (excluding fiz, HTTP providers, TestOnly,
    and in-process harnesses), honoring filter.Provider and deduping against
    provider-backed output. Filtered-by-harness behavior and scoring are
    unchanged.
    
    subprocessHarnessModelIDs is now a package-level var so tests can inject a
    hermetic model surface without launching real CLIs via PTY. newTestService
    defaults registry.LookPath to report no subprocess binaries so harness
    discovery is hermetic regardless of installed CLIs.
    
    Tests: TestListModelsUnfilteredIncludesAvailableSubscriptionTiers,
    TestListModelsFilteredByHarnessUnchanged.
